title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The momentous occasion is finally upon us! The Tokyo Yushun, the Japanese Derby, the race of all races!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Today, the Umamusume most blessed by the heavens shall be revealed! What joy! What bliss!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But, do I really have to run? I'm already taking on the role of oracle, so…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'm kidding, really! I'm all fired up, you know! Plus, I need to keep my promise to Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: My sister was great, but Suzuka is like, ten times more capable than even her. She's like ten sisters rolled into one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But that's not going to stop me from beating her!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: …Is what I wish I was cool enough to say. But I'll put on a brave face and give it my all, at least.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I usually get by on luck, so I should be able to put on a good race for you, Trainer.
choice_data_list: All right! Show everyone what you can do!
All right! Show everyone what you can do!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Right! My warding spells are all set to protect me from this monster of a race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I am a blessed Uma, a veritable picture of good health! I vow to carry myself to the finish line and accomplish my goals!
